definitions.explanation: A solid layer of rock beneath soil and loose material. The geological foundation.
Used figuratively for a firm, unshakeable foundation of support, often in political or business contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧{岩盤|がんばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぶつかった→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{岩盤|がんばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: This area is resistant to earthquakes because the bedrock is shallow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{岩盤浴|がんばんよく}→岩盤浴：09832_ganbanyoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧きた。
examples.english: I went to a hot stone bath.

examples.japanese: {岩盤|がんばん}{支持層|しじそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{崩|くず}れていない→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧。
examples.english: The bedrock support base hasn't crumbled.

examples.japanese: {岩盤規制|がんばんきせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Reforming deeply entrenched regulations is difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{岩盤|がんばん}{支持層|しじそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}らぎ→揺らぐ：07601_yuragu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The ruling party's core support base has started to waver.

notes:
Compound of {岩|がん} (rock) and ⟦{盤|ばん}→盤：18576_ban⟧ (plate/base). The literal geological meaning extends naturally into figurative use, especially in Japanese political discourse where {岩盤|がんばん}{支持層|しじそう} (bedrock supporters) and {岩盤規制|がんばんきせい} (rock-solid regulations that resist reform) are common phrases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{岩盤浴|がんばんよく}→岩盤浴：09832_ganbanyoku⟧: hot stone bath — a spa treatment where one lies on heated rock
- {岩盤|がんばん}{支持層|しじそう}: core support base; bedrock supporters
- {岩盤規制|がんばんきせい}: rock-solid regulations; deeply entrenched regulations
- {岩盤|がんばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧: to dig into bedrock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地盤|じばん}→地盤：04035_jiban⟧: ground; foundation — refers to the ground or foundation (geological or political territory), less about hardness
- ⟦{基盤|きばん}→基盤：00220_kiban⟧: base; foundation — abstract foundation (of a system, economy, etc.)
- ⟦{土台|どだい}→土台：07146_dodai⟧: foundation; base — the literal or figurative base on which something is built
